# sq-12 — squalify must publish and enforce descriptor schema v1

Freezes the descriptor at `schemaVersion` `1.0`. This slice:
- publishes `schema/descriptor-v1.schema.json`, written in a JSON Schema 2020-12 subset, closed (`additionalProperties: false`, closed enums), describing exactly what 1.0.0 produces (owner decisions S12-6, S12-7, 2026-10-29);
- validates every golden and the consistent writer model against it, with an in-repo subset validator in the test project;
- makes the versioning policy normative (including: adding an enum value is a minor change) and marks the members that no profiler produces yet as planned for a 1.x minor release;
- documents the known limits that freeze with v1 (unit-table single-letter false positives, the degC alias, the shape-mask `?` and `+` rules);
- does a final docs pass.

## Why

Goal: a stable, versioned descriptor schema.

Owner decision (2026-10-13): an in-repo subset validator in the test project only. The BCL has no JSON Schema validator, and the owner declined a package for it.

## Files

- `schema/descriptor-v1.schema.json`. It uses only these keywords: `$schema`, `$id`, `type`, `required`, `properties`, `additionalProperties`, `enum`, `const`, `items`, `minimum`, `maximum`, `pattern`, `$ref`/`$defs`, `oneOf`. It is closed: `additionalProperties: false` everywhere and closed enums (issue codes, evidence stages, families), checking squalify output of that exact minor. It covers what 1.0.0 produces, including `limits.sketches` (sq-38), `limits.nullSpellings` (sq-42, sq-43), `scope` (sq-35), the sq-32 omission rules (a member absent means null, so those members are optional, and `name`, `rawName`, `nameParts`, `nameParts.unit`, `nullTokens`, `constant`, `statsWithheld` are nullable as the consumer subset lists).
- `tests/squalify.Tests/Schema/SubsetValidator.cs`: implements exactly that subset and rejects any other keyword when the schema loads; it reports errors as a JSON pointer plus message (all errors, in document order; state the choice).
- The schema and the docs are COPIED into the test output (not found through `CallerFilePath`), so the schema tests do not depend on the source tree layout (owner decision S12-9).
- `tests/squalify.Tests/TestModels.cs` and its writer-model goldens: make the delimited writer model consistent (16 hex digit row class ids, class counts adding up to the row count, a fingerprint version and `sha256:` hashes of the real shape) and keep it in the schema test; the stdf model stays only as a key-order pin and is not validated (owner decision S12-5).
- `docs/descriptor.md`: the "draft" label is dropped, the policy becomes normative, a changelog is added (the starting point and format are decided by the implementer and listed). Documented rules (owner decisions S12-1, S12-3, S12-4, S12-8): the unit-table limitation (single-letter units in the underscore form read as units: Site_A as amps, Temp_F as farad; the degC alias, DEGC is a unit and DEG is not; `unitTable` 1 stays), the shape-mask `?` (a literal `?` or a character with no class) and the cut-mask `+` (a cut mask has exactly 65 tokens and ends in a bare `+`), and "adding an enum value is a minor change". Members documented but produced by nothing yet (`stdf`, `hints.stdf`, the touchstone and keyValue dialects, `sections`, `binary.blocks` and `binary.segments`, `limits.stdfTests`, the `kind` labels beyond the interim ones) are marked as planned for a 1.x minor release and are NOT in the v1.0 schema (owner decision S12-6).
- `README.md`: the usage examples become real output (run them).
- `docs/how-it-works.md`: final pass (banner status, text), and re-render.
- `Descriptor.SchemaVersion` is already `1.0` (there is no `ToolInfo.SchemaVersion`; the earlier spec was wrong).

Refresh 2026-10-30 (wave to 1.0.0; the spec above predates sq-46, sq-47 and sq-49): the schema also covers sq-46 members (`issues[].regions`, an enum of the 8 region names preamble, annotation, header, units, data, footer, unknown, other, the same length as `offsets`; `encoding.invalidBytesTolerated` const true) and sq-47 members (`layoutOnly` optional const true; `hints` and `fingerprint.typed` typed `[object,null]` and `[string,null]` with the pattern; a layout-only field shape with no count, nulls or nullsExcludingAllNullRows). Test-project files that change for these: `tests/squalify.Tests/Schema/SchemaWalker.cs` (Walk must union oneOf alternatives or key them separately; At must follow oneOf), `DescriptorInvariants` (CheckField must skip fields when layoutOnly, and hold the correlation rule: layoutOnly iff hints null iff typed null iff every field bare, no type-stage evidence), `DocumentedMembers` (no 'path documented twice' on the layout-only table.fields[] row), `SubsetValidator` (report the errors of the oneOf alternative whose required set matched, not 'matches none of 2'), `SchemaMutationTests` pointers. Pack-test note of 2026-10-27 (sq-26 gate) is stale: sq-41 added README, XML doc and license assertions to the Package tests.

## Failing tests

1. `Schema_UsesOnlySupportedKeywords`: the schema uses only the keywords listed; the validator rejects any other keyword at load.
2. `AllGoldens_ValidateAgainstSchema`: a theory over every `*.squalify.json` golden under the fixtures, plus the consistent delimited writer model; the stdf writer model is excluded (key-order pin only).
3. `Validator_RejectsKnownBadDescriptors`: a missing required key, a wrong type, an unknown enum value, and an extra key (the schema is closed).
4. `Schema_PropertiesMatchTheDocumentedMembers`: the set of member names per section in the schema equals the set of produced members documented in descriptor.md (no undocumented property, no documented and produced member missing, planned members absent from both). Key ORDER is not checked here (the existing `Writer_KeyOrder_MatchesSchemaDoc` covers order, and a JSON Schema cannot express it).
5. `Descriptor_SchemaVersion_MatchesTheSchema`: the written `schemaVersion` equals the schema const, and `Descriptor.SchemaVersion` is `1.0`.
6. `Schema_ClosedEnumsMatchTheCode`: the issue codes, evidence stages and families in the schema enums equal the sets the code defines or can produce (no code the profiler can emit is missing; none listed that it cannot).
7. `Schema_Tests_DoNotNeedTheSourceTree`: the schema and docs are read from the test output copy (a test that fails when they are absent from the output).
8. `Docs_StateTheFreezeRules`: descriptor.md states the policy as normative, "adding an enum value is a minor change", the unit-table limitation, the shape-mask `?` and `+` rules, and marks the unproduced members as planned (a docs test in the style of the existing ones).
9. `Readme_Examples_AreRealOutput`: the README usage example output matches a real run on the fixture it names.
Mutation check: remove a `required` entry (test 3 goes red), add a property to the writer without the schema (test 2 or 4 goes red), add an issue code without the enum (test 6 goes red).

Refresh 2026-10-30, tests added to the list above:
10. `Goldens_IncludeALayoutOnlyDescriptor`: a layout-only golden exists and validates (today none does, so `AllGoldens_ValidateAgainstSchema` never exercises the shape).
11. `Schema_LayoutOnlyFields_UseTheirOwnShape`: a layout-only descriptor validates; a full descriptor with a layout-only field (and the reverse) is rejected, and the error names the matching alternative.
12. `Invariants_LayoutOnly_CorrelationRule`: layoutOnly iff hints null iff typed null iff every field bare, with no type-stage evidence; a descriptor that breaks it is rejected by the invariants.
13. `Schema_RegionsEnum_MatchesTheCode`: `issues[].regions` enumerates exactly the 8 region names the code defines (extends test 6).
14. `Docs_StatePolicyForNullableMembers`: descriptor.md says whether sq-47's opt-in nulling of an always-present member is a precedent (owner decision pending, see Implement), and the cut rule and window sniff of sq-40 (a change that moves `scope.bytesRead` is a change of meaning).
15. `Schema_NullSpellingRules_AreNotPinned`: the schema pins no maximum or const 64 for null spellings; the cross-member rules (Distinct present exactly when Other is; Distinct <= Other; Capped implies Distinct == maxDistinctOther) are checked by the validator tests and stated in descriptor.md.

2. Write the schema, then tests 2, 4, 5, 6, 7; fix the delimited writer model (test 2).
3. Docs pass: descriptor.md (normative policy, changelog, the documented rules, planned members marked), README examples from real output (test 9), how-it-works.md final pass and re-render, then test 8.
4. Mutation checks as listed under Failing tests.
5. Waits on sq-38, sq-39, sq-40, sq-41, sq-42 and sq-43 landing: the schema covers their members. Decisions already recorded in the notes: S12-1 keep v1 and document, S12-3/4/8/9 accepted, S12-5, S12-6, S12-7, S12-10 (this rewrite), S12-11 moved to sq-41.

Owner decisions (2026-10-30), verbatim: Nullable policy "Allowed only behind an explicit top-level marker (Recommended)" (option text: "Policy states: a member may become null only when a documented top-level marker (like layoutOnly) is present; otherwise nulling is a major change."). Sketch values "Yes, state it in the policy (Recommended)" (option text: "Policy: sketched values are approximate and may be refined in a minor; keys, types and the rankError contract stay."). Size "Split into two slices (Recommended)" (option text: "(a) schema + validator + goldens + invariants + tests 1-7, 10-13, 15; (b) docs pass: normative policy, changelog, README examples, how-it-works, tests 8, 9, 14. SPLIT: this slice keeps the schema, the validator, the walker, the invariants, the layout-only golden, the writer-model fix and tests 1-7, 10-13, 15. The docs pass (descriptor.md policy, changelog, documented limits, planned-members marking, README examples, how-it-works final pass, and tests 8, 9, 14) moved to sq-54, which waits on this slice.
